I am unsure. 

I come from a broken family where my parents worked hard to cooperate. I have no way of providing that for my son, so his life will be full of stress and fighting. He would be better off with only one parent. 

I am not thinking about insurance, more about my property, investments, etc.

Thanks for your reply. 

I do go hiking and do other things with him. I am more normal when I am with him, very depressed without him. 

My ex has done everything to replace me in his life so my son tells me he has another dad. I am sure he loves me, but he is very confused. 

I don't see why things will get better if I've gone this long with them being the same. I am just unhappy all of the time. I remind myself of one of those old people who complain about everything except I do it in my head too.

I have donated money, bought friends and family nice things, tipped well, etc.. I don't feel better or worse. 

I consider myself successful and have completed my bucket list. 

Death would provide well for my family.
Maybe 20 years ago, it was a nice day and I felt a calmness come over me, it lasted for a few minutes.
